notes.title: Platforms, Controllers, and Languages, Oh My!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for your support of A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654992/db05fa05e68bab9ec015a2f1dda90729d45d5609.jpg"]


We have officially reached 1,000 wishlists!

To celebrate, I have some big announcements.

Platform Support 
APGTMYM will support Windows, macOS, and Linux at launch! This means if you use a Steam Deck, native Linux and proton-supported builds will be available. 


Controller Support 
Full controller support has been added to APGTMYM! You can use you Xbox controller, PlayStation controller, Switch controller, or maybe even that weird controller you found at that garage sale! The controls feel great on the Steam Deck too!


Localization
I have planned to support 17 languages at the launch of APGTMYM! This includes:

English

Simplified Chinese

Traditional Chinese

Japanese

Korean

Thai

Turkish

Russian

Ukrainian

German

French

Italian

Spanish (Spain)

Spanish (Latin America)

Portuguese (Brazil)

Polish

Czech



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654992/23bfd32b7ffdb4ee6229388393026921ca38e61d.jpg"]


A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad is coming sooner than you think! 

Stay tuned for updates and get ready to get mad!

notes.title: A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad Announcement
notes.content:
Thank You ːsteamthumbsupː
First off, Thank You to everyone who has supported development thus far! All the positive reception to the project has been amazing and I am excited to keep making the game better for you all!


Release Schedule
"A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad" is planned for release in Late 2025. I want to ensure the game is on track to be a quality, bug-free experience before I announce a release date. 

Development Update
I will be providing development updates from here on out. I am a solo developer and I am always looking for feedback on the game mechanics and visuals of the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654992/052b168aad7e67b56301032a9afce1115bc95ce0.png"]

Here are some features that are in development right now:

Checkpoints and Skipping

Less-hardcore players will be able to optionally enable checkpoints, so the game doesn't make you quite so mad. Checkpoint skipping can also be enabled, allowing you to skip a section if you can't quite get past an obstacle.

Themes

Themes allow you to changes the appearance and sounds of the game to spice up the experience. Some themes are "Classic", "Duck", and "Cat". 

New Obstacles

New obstacles are constantly being added to add new ways to challenge your flipper skills. How's your balance?

Physics Improvements

The physics engine is being reworked to ensure that the game feels consistent and controllable. The game should make you mad, but not because of physics bugs.
